The rankings file was parsed and diffed anyway rather than short-circuited on the manifest: 44 blocks, whitelisting categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} PLUS sortField === "lowerBound" PLUS keyRange === undefined (the whitelist matters — melee and ranged are SUBSETS of dps and would double-count 27 specs) gives 27+7+6 = 40 rows, and all 40 match stored exactly in value, n and asOf at 1 dp. The web page was NOT fetched (stale S3 prerender) and r.jina.ai was not used. asOf stays the source's own snapshotDate 2026-09-01, four days behind the run, so success is not claimable; the real staleness alarm is maxAgeDays 8 in the contract, which is not yet breached. Nothing was written to data/.
